meta.name: python-executor
meta.description: Execute Python code in a safe sandboxed environment via [inference.sh](https://inference.sh). Pre-installed: NumPy, Pandas, Matplotlib, requests, BeautifulSoup, Selenium, Playwright, MoviePy, Pillow, OpenCV, trimesh, and 100+ more libraries. Use for: data processing, web scraping, image manipulation, video creation, 3D model processing, PDF generation, API calls, automation scripts. Triggers: python, execute code, run script, web scraping, data analysis, image processing, video editing, 3D models, automation, pandas, matplotlib

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在沙箱中安全执行 Python 代码，处理数据、抓取网页、编辑图像视频。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要安全运行 Python 代码并调用大量预装库。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以执行 Python 代码，完成数据处理、网页抓取、图像处理、视频制作、3D 模型处理、PDF 生成、API 调用和自动化脚本等任务。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 执行 Python 代码、运行脚本、进行网页抓取、数据分析、图像处理、视频编辑或处理 3D 模型等时触发。

say.text: 用 Python 抓取这个网页的标题。
say.note: Claude 会运行代码并返回结果。

say.text: 帮我用 pandas 分析这份销售数据。
say.note: Claude 会处理数据并输出分析结果。

say.text: 用 MoviePy 生成一个 3 秒的彩色视频。
say.note: Claude 会创建视频文件并返回。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can execute Python code for tasks like data processing, web scraping, image manipulation, video creation, 3D model processing, PDF generation, API calls, and automation scripts.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to execute Python code, run scripts, perform web scraping, data analysis, image processing, video editing, or handle 3D models.

say_en.text: Scrape the title of this webpage using Python.
say_en.note: Claude will run the code and return the result.

say_en.text: Analyze this sales data with pandas.
say_en.note: Claude will process the data and output analysis.

say_en.text: Create a 3-second color video with MoviePy.
say_en.note: Claude will generate the video file and return it.
